capabilities: Select external files from a picker and insert links into notes
Configure custom prefixes for multiple file links
Toggle file extension visibility in links
Choose whether links open files or their containing folders
Detect broken external file links across all notes
disambiguation: It links to files outside the vault rather than managing files inside it.
extras: Links to a demo video; lists supported embed file types (documents, images, audio, video).
problem: Adding links to files outside the vault normally requires manual drag-and-drop from the file system.
summary: File link plugin that lets you pick external files from within Obsidian and insert links or embedded previews into notes.
